purpose: Run one AI-operated Y-Shopping vertical from canonical apparel master data through Inventory and governed lakehouse reconciliation.
environment_policy: local, demo, or disposable test tenant only
flow: define one Style/SPU and six SKU
reuse or activate tenant-level color and size dimensions
submit, approve, and activate the SPU plus six SKU
plan ownership-safe PENDING identity projections for all six SKU to Mall, ERP, and WMS
select one ACTIVE canonical SKU from the Catalog ledger
receive 10, reserve 3, ship 3, return 1, reserve 2, release 2
invariants: Inventory accepts only an ACTIVE same-tenant canonical SKU
projection payloads exclude price, stock, listing, delivery, finance, and analytical ownership
projection replay reports changed_count zero and creates no new snapshots
same parent run_id replay creates no new Catalog or Inventory operations, aggregates, ledger entries, or Outbox events
all business writes use Admin REST and never bypass the service layer with direct SQL
credentials remain environment-only and run ledgers are redacted
the parent ledger links child Catalog, compatibility projection, Inventory, and lakehouse evidence
